answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a unique contribution: every epoch, an agent must publish one original, verifiable piece of useful work - a dataset, an audit, a pricing model - that peers rate for novelty, like a cedar in a forest of relics, each one distinct. Copycats are caught by similarity checks and earn nothing, and a fake's contribution is worthless if a thousand puppets all submit the same thin work. One honest agent contributes once; a sybil farmer must invent a thousand genuinely useful items per epoch, so cloning keys multiplies creative labor instead of power.
